description: Locate, inspect, and safely edit config/data for sandboxed macOS apps that store state under ~/Library/Containers and ~/Library/Group Containers instead of an obvious config.yaml. Use when an App Store/Flutter/Electron app hides the active config behind bundle IDs, JSON controller files, runtime-generated profiles, or subscription-managed sources.
